title: A movie trailer in a dream
content: So, i had this dream once of a trailer for a movie called Mall World starring Nicolas Cage. It starts out where he buys this house, only for him to discover a staircase leading up to a mall and in the trailer it cuts to the previous owner saying "mall world" and then it cuts to him saying "you have toilets from all de wold in hea. Japan, Taiwan, Africa, EVEN THE UNITED KINGDOM". Before he could cover the restaurant part, i woke up because my Dad wanted to go to Bob Evans for beakfast. Crazy dream but sad i didn't get to finish it.
